title: Example: RTP Interface with Formula COPYO1
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM

— Recommendation
If you want to distinguish between Winter weekdays and Winter weekends when you execute the components, but you want

Summer weekdays and Summer weekends to be treated equally, define the parameter allocations of the component codes
Winter Weekdays, Winter Weekends, and Default. The default parameter alllocations are used for Summer weekdays and

Summer Weekends.

Example: RTP Interface with Formula COPYO1
